text: No. "2026-01-15" is not a plain decimal, while the filter value 5 is (numbers are compared in plain decimal form). Per the Moss "How ranges compare" rules, when one value is a plain decimal and the other is not, the range operators ($gt, $gte, $lt, $lte) never match, so the document is not matched (no error is raised). The two sides must be the same kind: both plain decimals (compared as numbers) or both text (compared character by character). To filter dates numerically, store createdAt as a Unix epoch-seconds string (e.g. "1768435200") and filter with a number; to keep ISO strings, filter with an ISO string such as {"$gt": "2026-01-01"}, which compares as text and works only if every value uses one fixed zero-padded UTC format. Requires moss >= 1.15.0 (Python), @moss-js/moss >= 1.16.0 (JS).
